items.title: Observing AI Agents with OpenTelemetry
items.author: CNCF [Cloud Native Computing Foundation]
items.content:
<article>OpenTelemetry now provides the universal language for observing non-deterministic AI agents.

In this keynote from KubeCon + CloudNativeCon Japan, OpenTelemetry Governance Committee member and maintainer Alolita Sharma discusses the critical role of GenAI semantic conventions. She explains how the project is creating a standardized schema for describing and observing agentic execution in modern applications.

By utilizing OpenTelemetry's mature open source standards and community-driven efforts, teams can now achieve true end-to-end observability for even the most complex agentic workflows.

#Shorts #OpenTelemetry #CNCF #CloudNative #Observability #AI #KubeCon</article>

items.title: Cloud Native Live: Kubernetes v1.37 webinar
items.author: CNCF [Cloud Native Computing Foundation]
items.content: <article>Similar to previous releases, the release of Kubernetes v1.37 introduces new stable, beta, and alpha features. This release consists of 67 enhancements. Of those enhancements, 17 have graduated to Stable, 22 have graduated to Beta, and 27 are entering Alpha. Tune in to see the latest and greatest from the Kubernetes v1.37 Release Team!</article>
